attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Alabama state income tax calculation. Implements progressive tax structure per AL tax code (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Alabama Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Alabama tax - Single filer (progressive brackets)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.al_standard_deduction_single sub result.al_exemption_single sub 0 max /al_taxable_income xdef
0 /al_tax xdef
al_taxable_income result.al_bracket_1_limit_single min result.al_bracket_1_rate mul al_tax add /al_tax xdef
al_taxable_income result.al_bracket_1_limit_single gt { al_taxable_income result.al_bracket_2_limit_single min result.al_bracket_1_limit_single sub 0 max result.al_bracket_2_rate mul al_tax add /al_tax xdef } if
al_taxable_income result.al_bracket_2_limit_single gt { al_taxable_income result.al_bracket_2_limit_single sub result.al_bracket_3_rate mul al_tax add /al_tax xdef } if
al_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Alabama tax (Single) calculated: $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Alabama tax - Married filing jointly (progressive brackets)

al_taxable_income result.al_bracket_1_limit_joint min result.al_bracket_1_rate mul al_tax add /al_tax xdef
al_taxable_income result.al_bracket_1_limit_joint gt { al_taxable_income result.al_bracket_2_limit_joint min result.al_bracket_1_limit_joint sub 0 max result.al_bracket_2_rate mul al_tax add /al_tax xdef } if
al_taxable_income result.al_bracket_2_limit_joint gt { al_taxable_income result.al_bracket_2_limit_joint sub result.al_bracket_3_rate mul al_tax add /al_tax xdef } if
al_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Alabama tax (MFJ) calculated: $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_postfix:

0 /al_tax xdef
al_taxable_income result.al_bracket_1_limit_single min result.al_bracket_1_rate mul al_tax add /al_tax xdef
al_taxable_income result.al_bracket_1_limit_single gt { al_taxable_income result.al_bracket_2_limit_single min result.al_bracket_1_limit_single sub 0 max result.al_bracket_2_rate mul al_tax add /al_tax xdef } if

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Alabama military retirement income exclusion. Provides 100% exclusion for military retirement pay and SBP payments. Honors MSRRA (spouse income exempt if different domicile) and SCRA (active duty pay exempt if different state of residence). Per AL Code § 40-18-19 (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Alabama Military Retirement Exclusion Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0 /result.al_military_retirement_exclusion xdef 0 /result.al_sbp_exclusion xdef
initial_action.action_comment: Initialize Alabama military retirement exclusion calculation

action_details.action_comment: Apply full exclusion for military retirement pay and SBP payments
action_details.action_postfix:
taxpayer.military_retirement_pay /result.al_military_retirement_exclusion xdef
taxpayer.sbp_payments 0 gt { taxpayer.sbp_payments /result.al_sbp_exclusion xdef } if
result.al_military_retirement_exclusion result.al_sbp_exclusion add /result.al_total_military_exclusion xdef
result.agi result.al_total_military_exclusion sub 0 max /result.al_adjusted_agi xdef
"Alabama military retirement exclusion: $" result.al_military_retirement_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.al_sbp_exclusion 0 gt { "Alabama SBP exclusion: $" result.al_sbp_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto } if "Alabama total military exclusion: $" result.al_total_military_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
